valuation.method: Forward EPS x justified P/E, with the forward period viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027) taken as FY2028 non-GAAP diluted EPS. Anchor: FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance of $16.67-$16.71 (midpoint $16.69, company guidance raised 26 Aug 2026) on about 838M guided diluted shares. Scenario FY2028 EPS = $16.69 x (1 + growth), growth assumed at 2% bear, 10% base and 18% bull. Revenue guidance of $46.1-$46.4B (+11-12%) is the reference for the base growth. Price targets are per share in USD on the NYSE listing; no FX or ADR conversion applies.

bear.driver: Growth stalls near the low end of the guided revenue range and the market keeps the stock at a SaaS trough multiple

base.driver: Revenue grows about 11-12% as guided, Agentforce and Data 360 add to subscription growth, and buybacks lower the share count

bull.driver: AI and data ARR keeps compounding above 200%, operating margin expands and the multiple re-rates toward mature software peers

valuation.implied_by_close: At FY2027 guided EPS of $16.69 the close of $217.84 implies 13.1x; at base FY2028 EPS of $18.36 it implies 11.9x. The only named target in the sample (BofA $285) implies 15.5x base FY2028 EPS, or FY2028 EPS of $19.00 at 15x. A 12-month analyst-weighted target cannot be formed from the one dated call with a documented horizon.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $18.36 (about 6.7 pp of the $275 base). A 2-point change in FY2028 growth moves the base EPS by about $0.33 and the base target by about $5 at 15x.
valuation.watch_metric: Non-GAAP operating margin together with subscription and support revenue growth in FY2027 Q3 and Q4 (Q3 revenue guidance $11.42-$11.50B, adjusted EPS guidance $3.42-$3.44); a stall in AI and data ARR growth would argue for the bear case.
valuation.next_disclosure: FY2027 Q3 results (quarter ending October 2026) and FY2027 full-year guidance, as scheduled by the company; the release after the reference close is outside this research cut-off.

analyst_notes: The only named call dated and verified before the reference close is BofA's upgrade from Underperform to Buy with a target raised to $285 from $160 on 12 October 2026, valued at 16x calendar 2027 enterprise-value free cash flow, not a documented 12-month target, so it is kept out of the weighted target. The sample is thin: most other broker targets found in the search results were either dated 2023 or 2025, or fell after the cut-off, so this file cannot show how named views moved since the 26 August release. The $285 BofA target sits about 4% above the base case, which requires FY2028 EPS near $19 at 15x or a re-rating to about 15.5x base EPS; the gap is in the multiple, not in near-term EPS, which is already guided.
